description: Plain-language CDR route analytics. Each route is shown as Incoming Customer Trunk -> Outbound Vendor -> Outbound Vendor Trunk -> Outbound Media IP.

options.content:
### How to read this dashboard
**Incoming Customer Trunk** → **Outbound Vendor** → **Outbound Vendor Trunk** → **Outbound Media IP**

**Total Calls** = all CDRs · **Answered Calls** = SIP 200 · **Answer Rate** = answered / total · **Customer Charge** = `orig_cost` · **Vendor Cost** = `term_cost` · **Profit** = customer charge - vendor cost

panels.description: Every CDR in the selected time range and route filters, including answered and failed calls.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(attempts) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Total Calls

panels.description: Calls answered with SIP response code 200.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(completions) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Answered Calls

panels.description: Calls that did not receive SIP response code 200.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(attempts) - sum(completions) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Failed Calls

panels.description: Answered calls divided by total calls (ASR).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Answer Rate

panels.description: Customer-billed duration for answered calls, shown in minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(billed_seconds) / 60.0, 0) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Billable Minutes

panels.description: Amount billed to the customer from the raw orig_cost field.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Customer Charge

panels.description: Amount owed to the outbound vendor from the raw term_cost field.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(cost), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

panels.title: Vendor Cost

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip)

SELECT hour AS time, sum(attempts) AS `Total Calls`, sum(completions) AS `Answered Calls` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.description: The busiest exact call routes. Read each row from left to right: incoming customer trunk -> outbound vendor trunk -> outbound media IP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS Vendor, term_trunk_group_name AS `Outbound Trunk`, term_media_ip AS `Media IP`, sum(attempts) AS Calls, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `Answer Rate` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, term_media_ip ORDER BY Calls DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Busiest Routes

panels.description: One row is one exact route. Nothing is combined into vendor or trunk lists.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS `Outbound Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Outbound Vendor Trunk`, term_ip AS `Outbound Signaling IP`, term_media_ip AS `Outbound Media IP`, sum(attempts) AS Calls, sum(completions) AS Answered, sum(attempts) - sum(completions) AS Failed, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `Answer Rate`, round(sum(billed_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS `Billable Minutes`, round(sum(billed_seconds) / nullIf(sum(completions), 0), 1) AS `Avg Call Sec`, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS `Customer Charge`, round(sum(cost), 2) AS `Vendor Cost`, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS Profit FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, term_ip, term_media_ip ORDER BY Calls DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Route Details

panels.description: Failed calls grouped by the exact incoming trunk, outbound route, SIP response, and release reason.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS Vendor, term_trunk_group_name AS `Outbound Trunk`, term_media_ip AS `Media IP`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, reason AS `Release Reason`, sum(attempts) AS `Failed Calls` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND sip_code != 200 AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY orig_trunk_group_name, term_carrier_name, term_trunk_group_name, term_media_ip, sip_code, reason ORDER BY `Failed Calls` DESC LIMIT 250

panels.title: Why Calls Failed

panels.description: A simple customer-side view: one row per incoming customer trunk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, sum(attempts) AS Calls, sum(completions) AS Answered, sum(attempts) - sum(completions) AS Failed, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `Answer Rate`, round(sum(billed_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS `Billable Minutes`, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS `Customer Charge`, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS Profit FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) GROUP BY orig_trunk_group_name ORDER BY Calls DESC LIMIT 250

panels.title: Incoming Customer Trunks

panels.description: Individual CDRs with the incoming customer side first and the outbound vendor side second.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Call Started`, call_answered_time AS `Answered At`, call_end_time AS `Call Ended`, entity AS `CDR Source`, orig_carrier_name AS `Customer Carrier`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Incoming Customer Trunk`, orig_ip AS `Customer Signaling IP`, orig_media_ip AS `Customer Media IP`, term_carrier_name AS `Outbound Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Outbound Vendor Trunk`, term_ip AS `Outbound Signaling IP`, term_media_ip AS `Outbound Media IP`, from_did AS `From Number`, to_did AS `To Number`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, if(sip_code = 200, 'Answered', 'Failed') AS Result, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, duration_real AS `Call Duration Sec`, orig_billed_duration AS `Billable Sec`, round(orig_cost, 6) AS `Customer Charge`, round(term_cost, 6) AS `Vendor Cost`, round(orig_cost - term_cost, 6) AS Profit, stir_attest AS Attestation, round(mos_avg, 2) AS MOS, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}, $vendor) AND $__conditionalAll(term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}, $trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}, $media_ip) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Individual Calls (latest 1,000)

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity AS Entity, file_hour AS `File Hour`, file_path AS File, status AS Status, message AS Message, rows_ingested AS Rows, updated_at AS Updated FROM cdr.ingest_log FINAL WHERE status IN ('error', 'changed') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
